# Exploratory analysis

Goals
- Identify the best threshold to remove noise; improve quantitative predictions from ML
- plotting distributions

```{r loadStuff}
library(tidyverse, quietly = TRUE)
library(magrittr) # for special Tee pipe operator %T>% (Error check, unique WT before calc)

# import functions
source("functions/0.data_processing.R")
source("functions/1.plotting.R")

# locate the data
base_path <- "enrichment_data/theoAptzepPCR_lokya/"
# file_path <- str_c(base_path, "subset.tsv") # for testing
file_path <- str_c(base_path, "DiMSum_Project_variant_data_merge.tsv") # for production

# global variables
expected_variants <- 135000 # (epPCR) from colony counts (source: Lokya)
count_tracker <<- tibble(threshold = numeric(), variants = numeric(), reads = numeric())
```
## Data cleanup
- Select relevant columns
- Clean up column names
- Calculate enrichment, leak metrics
Ref: _Borrowing some code from DiMSum/[split-multiinputs.R](https://github.com/ppreshant/DiMSum/blob/master/scripts/split_multiinputs.R) 

```{r data-cleanup}
data <- read_and_cleanup_data(file_path)
cat("Column names: ", paste(colnames(data), collapse = ", "), "\n")

total_variants <- nrow(data)
total_reads <- sum(data$Input_count)
count_tracker <<- count_tracker |> add_row(threshold = 0, variants = total_variants, reads = total_reads)

cat("Total variants: ", format(total_variants, big.mark = ","), "\n")
cat("Total reads: ", format(total_reads, big.mark = ","), "\n")
```


## Visualizations
```{r raw_count_distribution}
#| fig-width: 2
#| fig-height: 3

# nham_variant_count_distribution(head(data, 1000)) # top 1,000 data
var_raw <- nham_variant_count_distribution(data) # all data
read_raw <- nham_read_count_distribution(data)
```

Looking at the distribution of Nham_nt counts, we can see that there are a lot of variants with low counts. We want to filter out these low-count variants to reduce noise in our analysis.

## Filtering variants with counts >= 2
```{r threshold_test}
#| fig-width: 2
#| fig-height: 3

d2 <- filter_data(data, 2)

var_2 <- nham_variant_count_distribution(d2)
read_2 <- nham_read_count_distribution(d2)
```

## Filtering variants with counts >= 5
```{r threshold_test}
#| fig-width: 2
#| fig-height: 3

d5 <- filter_data(data, 5)
var_5 <- nham_variant_count_distribution(d5)
read_5 <- nham_read_count_distribution(d5)
```

## Filtering variants with counts >= 10
```{r threshold_test}
#| fig-width: 2
#| fig-height: 3

d10 <- filter_data(data, 10)
var_10 <- nham_variant_count_distribution(d10)
read_10 <- nham_read_count_distribution(d10)
```

## Filtering variants with counts >= 100
```{r threshold_test}
#| fig-width: 2
#| fig-height: 3

d100 <- filter_data(data, 100)
var_100 <- nham_variant_count_distribution(d100)
read_100 <- nham_read_count_distribution(d100)
```

## Comparing plots for different thresholds

### Variant count distributions
```{r patch_variant_dist}
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 6

# Compare the variant count distributions for different thresholds
# plot the above plots side by side for comparison
var_plots <- var_raw + var_2 + var_5 + var_10 + var_100 + plot_layout(axes = "collect")

print(var_plots)
```

### Read count distributions

```{r patch_read_dist}
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 6

# plot the above plots side by side for comparison
read_plots <- read_raw + read_2 + read_5 + read_10 + read_100 + plot_layout(axes = "collect")

print(read_plots)
```


## Variant counts vs expected 

```{r variant_counts_vs_expected}
#| fig-width: 4
#| fig-height: 2

# plot the variant counts vs expected variants from count_tracker

ggplot(count_tracker, aes(x = threshold, y = variants)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_point() +

  # expected variants line
  geom_hline(yintercept = expected_variants, linetype = "dashed") +
  annotate("text", 
    x = max(count_tracker$threshold) * 0.7, 
    y = expected_variants + max(count_tracker$variants)/10, 
    label = str_c("Expected: ", format(expected_variants, big.mark = ","), " variants")) +

  labs(title = "Variant Counts with thresholds",
       x = "Count Threshold",
       y = "Number of Variants") +
  theme_minimal()

```
